comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Micron disclose specific amortization expenses for intangible assets in Item 8. While Micron provides a forward-looking projection of amortization expenses for the next five fiscal years (2025-2029), AMD reports historical acquisition-related intangible amortization expenses for completed fiscal years (2024 and 2023). Micron's projected expenses are significantly lower in magnitude (tens of millions) compared to AMD's reported acquisition-related amortization (billions), reflecting different scales or compositions of intangible asset bases.
